notes: 6 tests x 20 = 120 of 200 items (every pool at least 6x its per-test count; 3/4/3/2/2/2/2/2). The real theory part (rozporządzenie MSWiA z 28.07.2023, Dz. U. poz. 1475, § 4) is 20 single-choice questions with three options (A, B, C), 30 minutes, pass with at least 18 correct; Tigertest models it at the same length and line: passPct 90 = ceil(0.9 x 20) = 18 of 20. Our items have four options (v1 engine). Scope per § 4 ust. 1: ustawa o broni i amunicji with its implementing regulations and Kodeks karny provisions on weapon-related offences; the per-test split is Tigertest's own (no weights are published). Training: five topic sets 45801-45805 (28, 36, 32, 60, 44; all at most 60), dashboard 5 sets + 6 tests = 11 steps.
